integrity: The general transformation law is proved symbolically from the integral basis-change formula. The bundled verifier checks the standard matrices, fingerprints, and representative mutation/sign transformations for p=5 and p=7; finite checks are not used as a proof for arbitrary prime p.
scientific_limitations: The switching-class invariant is not claimed to classify the standard orbit, and no new numerical exceptional basis is constructed that is separated only by the triangle-square fingerprint. The result is a structural refinement of the recent modulo-p-squared obstruction.
title: A switching-class refinement of the \(p^2\) exceptional-basis obstruction
